Email Signature · free, in your browser

A free WiseStamp alternative, in your browser

If you want an email signature without making an account, Email Signature builds one in your browser from a short form and gives it to you to copy or download.

Try Email Signature

How to do it

  1. Type your details, social links and small print.
  2. Pick one of four templates, a colour and a font.
  3. Copy the signature, or take the HTML.
  4. Paste it into Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail with the steps on the page.

What it has: four templates, your colour and font, a logo or photo, six social networks as text links, a call-to-action line, small print, and HTML export. What it does not have: icons, banners that change, click tracking, or signatures managed for a whole team.

Your files stay on this device: Email Signature runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Email Signature made by WiseStamp?

No. ITpris Verktyg is not affiliated with WiseStamp. WiseStamp is a trademark of its owner, and the name is used here only to describe what people search for.

Is there a watermark?

No. The signature has no credit line, no link back and no tracking.

Do I need to install anything?

No. It runs in your browser; copy the signature and paste it into your mail program.
